text: I slipped and fell in a shopping centre in Newcastle. Which public liability lawyers are best?

result.keyword: I slipped and fell in a shopping centre in Newcastle. Which public liability lawyers are best?

items.markdown:
If you have suffered a slip and fall in a shopping centre, you are dealing with a public liability (occupier's liability) claim. In New South Wales, these claims typically require proving that the shopping centre or the cleaning/maintenance contractor breached their duty of care.[[1]](https://www.mauriceblackburn.com.au/injury-illness/public-place-injury/)

Several reputable law firms with local Newcastle offices handle public liability and personal injury claims on a **No Win, No Fee** basis.[[1]](https://conradcurrylaw.com.au/public-liability-lawyers/)
